thread:
olivia: Heads up — saw a sharp increase in 5xx for hosted inference around 09:12 UTC after the new routing toggle was promoted to 20% canary. :rotating_light:
eng-oncall: Noted, grabbing dashboards. Which toggle was promoted?
jess: It was `route.tag_v2` + `batching.window_zero` flip for the seed pool. Promoted at 09:05 per rollout logs.
mike: 20% is small but still. Any customer errors? support: Several customers in EU reported failed requests and retries hitting billing spikes. Raising a P1.
sam: Dumping gateway error rates now, streaming partial logs:```gateway: upstream_response=502 count=1270 window=10m
upstream_timeout=504 count=890
route=seed-v2 tag=tag_v2 canary_pct=20```
sarah: Is this the prefetched KV cache path change or the new shedder param? The canary touched both.
jess: Canary included `kvcache.prefetch=true` and `shedder.allow_burst=false` — might be interacting.
mike: Can we reproduce locally? Sam, any short repro steps?
sam: Quick repro: curl post to /v1/generate with header `x-route-tag: tag_v2` and long payload (~5k tokens) causes backend timeout after ~3s. Locally I see timeouts when batch size >4 and prefetch enabled.
olivia: Also seeing many 429->5xx cascades when the shedder rejects. Maybe fallback path isn't configured.
eng-oncall: I'm enabling extra tracing for affected requests, adding `X-Debug-Trace: canary-20` header capture.
sarah: We need immediate mitigation — either rollback the toggle or cut canary to 0. Who will coordinate?
mike: I can do a config rollback via config-service. Plan: set `route.tag_v2` back to OFF and scale canary to 0% then monitor 10m. Anyone object?
jess: +1, prefer rollback. Also add temporary rate-limit exemption for critical customers to reduce billing churn.
support: Please post the list of affected customer IDs so we can notify.
deploy-bot: [deploy-job] rollback-request accepted by mike. Job id: dj-20260317-09-35.
mike: Running rollback now:```# rollback via config-service
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/route.tag_v2 -d '{"state":"off","actor":"mike"}'
# set canary pct
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/api/v1/canary/seed -d '{"pct":0}'```
sam: Observability shows 5xx rate dropping in one of the seed clusters at 09:24 UTC. Gateway 502s down ~80% in 5m.
jess: Re-enabling shedder logs and adding guardrails: require fallback route for shedder rejects. Put a rollout policy to auto-fallback to `seed-v1`.
sarah: I'll open a quick runbook ticket: `RB-1739` with steps and rollback checklist.
eng-oncall: Deploy-bot reports rollback succeeded at 09:25. Confirmation from prod: latency returning to baseline, error rates falling.
olivia: Great. Support — please update affected customers and flag any billing anomalies.
support: Noted, sending batch notifications and refund checklist.
mike: Postmortem action items: 1) Add canary gating check for combined kvcache+shedders. 2) Automated canary abort if 5xx > threshold within 10m. 3) Add synthetic load test for long payload paths.
jess: I'll own #1 and #3. Sarah please coordinate the runbook updates.
sarah: On it. Creating PM ticket and linking to RB-1739.
sam: Saved logs and a minimal repro script here: https://internal/redwood/logs/6765432100-repro — includes `--payload-size` toggle.
olivia: Thanks everyone — closing incident chat. We'll sync in the postmortem at 11:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
